owner_scope: All repository-documented PVNetwork research work: first complete all 93 COMPLETE-RESEARCH-v1 gates, then COMPLETE-REFERENCE-v2 for all applicable entries. Completion of one protocol/family is never overall completion.

hard_phase_lock.reason: V1 tracker is 8/93 COMPLETE-RESEARCH-v1. V2 evidence may be preserved or captured incidentally, but V2 must not be the active campaign until V1 reaches 93/93.
forbidden_while_locked: select a new V2-only work unit instead of reconciling unfinished V1 gates
use missing runtime/device/packet-capture/certification evidence as a hidden research-completion gate unless the written V1 contract explicitly requires it

active_work_unit.exact_next_action: Reconcile entry 001 OpenVPN against all 20 original-v1 gates using its deep OpenVPN family dossier and client references. Promote only when every applicable research gate is traceably evidence-backed or evidence-backed N/A. Missing runtime/device/Store/interoperability proof is not a hidden research gate. If a genuine research-contract gap remains, persist the precise gap and continue another mature V1 entry. Keep V2 locked until 93/93 V1.

resume_policy.on_single_task_blocker: record blocker, change strategy after two failed attempts, continue independent required V1 work
resume_policy.on_platform_interruption: treat as interruption not completion; next invocation resumes from repository checkpoint immediately
resume_policy.on_work_unit_pass: update tracker, checkpoint, and immediately select next unfinished V1 entry until V1 is 93/93
resume_policy.overall_stop_gate: all required v1 and v2 gates PASS, or every remaining task is externally blocked and no independent work remains

files: research/REFERENCE_V2_COMPLETENESS.md only when V2 is legitimately active
docs/PROJECT_STATE.md or a dated status snapshot
